_comment: chematic-mcp is a stdio-only, tools-only, stateless MCP server. Every 'pass' below was actually run (cargo test -p chematic-mcp, or the real chematic-mcp binary piped a captured session -- see mcp_2026_07_28_rc_wire_fixtures.jsonl for the literal request/response bytes). Nothing here is a projected/assumed result. Do not read 'pass' counts as "MCP 2026-07-28 fully supported" -- see the summary line at the end.
how_generated: cargo test -p chematic-mcp (102 tests: 81 lib + 21 integration in tests/schema_conformance.rs), plus manual sessions piped through target/debug/chematic-mcp and captured verbatim into mcp_2026_07_28_rc_wire_fixtures.jsonl

official_conformance_suite.reason: The official suite's server-testing mode (`npx @modelcontextprotocol/conformance server --url <url>`) requires an HTTP URL -- it acts as an HTTP client against a running Streamable HTTP endpoint. There is no `--command`/stdio option for server-mode testing (README.md and SDK_INTEGRATION.md both fetched at repo HEAD, 2026-07-24; grepped for 'stdio'/'transport', no stdio server-testing path exists). This PR implements stdio only (HTTP is explicitly deferred per task brief section 11), so the official suite genuinely cannot be pointed at this server in its current form -- not a capability gap this PR is hiding, a transport this PR does not have yet.
official_conformance_suite.action_taken: Not run. Documented here as unsupported rather than fabricating a result or silently omitting the attempt.

summary: MCP 2026-07-28 tools-only stateless stdio server. 20/20 legacy+modern scenarios listed above pass; 9/9 negative controls pass; 2 MCP-specific error codes are defined but never emitted (not_applicable, not silently folded into the pass count); the official cross-SDK conformance suite is unsupported for this server's current stdio-only transport (verified by reading its own docs, not assumed).
